notes.title: 1.9.6 colorful coordinate update
notes.notes:
Updated to 1.9.6.
A color coordination feature has been added that allows you to change the color of Hazumi's hair, pubic hair, and eyes.
Two new items have been added to the pharmacy after starting the game. Purchase them and then check the mirror in your room.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36763405/43da27b22a286baee0e73cf12ef63156f6604869.png

Because of changes in the way pictures are loaded, there may be compatibility issues with existing mods.
If the pictures do not display properly, try putting the official mod "LegacyParts" in the Official_Mods folder.
It will revert the images to the loading method used up to 1.7, so previous mods should also work.

If you still have problems, you can downgrade to v1.7.4.
Right-click "Hazzumi and the Land of Childbirth" from the library of the Steam app -> Properties
→select [old1.7] from the Beta tab.
